name: Southwest Airlines
note: Southwest's help-centre baggage page states the size and weight limits but routes fees to a separate travel-fees page. Only the limits are recorded here. Southwest ended bags-fly-free in 2025 and rebuilt its fare structure in January 2026, so a great deal of published material about this carrier describes a policy that no longer exists — which is exactly why the fee is left blank rather than guessed.

baggage.label: Checked bag limits
caveats: Southwest's baggage policy page states limits but not fees. It links to a separate travel-fees page for the amounts, which we have not read, so no fee is printed here.
Checked bag fees apply. The long-standing bags-fly-free policy ended in 2025.
Bags can be checked digitally from 24 hours before departure once you have checked in, or at an airport kiosk or counter.
If your bag is overweight or oversized and you pay at the airport, Southwest requires a physical credit card. Contactless, tap-to-pay and mobile payments are refused for these fees.
Baggage embargoes apply to some countries, restricting oversized, overweight and extra checked bags.
On a partner itinerary, the operating carrier's baggage policy may apply instead of Southwest's.
